description: Baseline: streaming Keylock engine quality benchmark (real music 40s slow/fast/identity/ride + sine ride). quality=81.87

asi.hypothesis: baseline
asi.biggest_levers: transient_f1 fast render 0.489 (smearing on speedup); identity_corr 0.505 at rate 1.0 (keylock chain not transparent)

description: Harness calibration (not a DSP change): compensate reported pipeline latency in transient F1, phase-blind identity metric (LR8 allpass), add hard ±14-16% ratios. New effective baseline 95.34.

asi.hypothesis: harness had latency bias + phase-sensitive identity metric
asi.finding: transient_f1 0.61->0.92 purely from latency compensation; identity xcorr 0.50 was allpass phase, spectral sim is 0.991
asi.levers: spec_sim slow2 (-16%) = 0.916 worst; transient_f1 ~0.92 all rates

description: SOLA TRANSIENT_POSTPONE_RATIO 3.0→1.8: postpone splices near weaker energy bursts. transient_f1 0.9188→0.9210, tiny but real (deterministic bench).

asi.hypothesis: more conservative online transient postpone protects more attacks
asi.result: +0.066 quality via transient_f1 +0.0022; small because postpone only delays, doesn't relocate splices
asi.next: try shorter/longer XFADE, DRIFT_TRIGGER, or outgoing-span energy check

description: DRIFT_TRIGGER 192→128 + HARD 320→256: more frequent smaller splices. Worse everywhere: spec −0.0014, transient −0.0023, pitch p95 0.43→0.71c.

asi.hypothesis: smaller more frequent splices reduce per-splice damage
asi.rollback_reason: quality 95.41→94.76; more splices = more fades = more pitch wobble and more attack smears
asi.next_action_hint: try the opposite: LARGER drift trigger (fewer splices), e.g. 256/384

description: DRIFT_TRIGGER 192→256 + HARD 320→448: fewer larger splices. Also worse: transient_f1 0.921→0.902, pitch 0.43→0.55c. 192/320 is a local optimum.

asi.hypothesis: fewer larger splices = less total fade damage
asi.rollback_reason: quality 95.41→94.63; larger jumps skip/repeat more audio per splice, hurting transients (0.921→0.902)
asi.learning: DRIFT/HARD trigger 192/320 is locally optimal in both directions; stop tuning it
asi.next_action_hint: focus on splice PLACEMENT (online onset detection feeding OnsetEvents) instead of splice frequency

description: Online onset detection at SOLA ingest (RMS jump 2.5x, refractory 46ms) feeding both splice protection and masked-window placement. transient_f1 0.921→0.910 — worse.

asi.hypothesis: online attack detection at ingest (~13ms lookahead) protects transients from splice fades
asi.suspect: masked-window opportunistic splices now fire 17-46ms AFTER each detected kick — inside the kick body/decay — smearing it; or postponed splices get forced at HARD_TRIGGER in worse spots
asi.next_action_hint: retry with online onsets used for span PROTECTION only (not masked-window placement)

description: Online onset detection, protection-only variant (no masked-window use). Still worse than baseline: transient_f1 0.921→0.915.

asi.hypothesis: online onsets for fade-span protection only
asi.learning: onset protection postpones splices past DRIFT_TRIGGER; the forced splices at HARD_TRIGGER are then LARGER jumps, which experiment #4/#5 showed hurt more than fade-through-transient does. The existing energy-postpone (1.8x) already covers the useful cases
asi.next_action_hint: stop onset-protection direction; attack transient smearing differently — e.g. splice landing refinement, or XFADE shape/length

description: XFADE_FRAMES 96→64 (~1.45ms splice fades): transient_f1 0.921→0.928, quality 95.41→95.58. Pitch max 0.53→0.69c (still tiny vs 22c gate).

asi.hypothesis: shorter fades smear less audio per splice
asi.result: +0.17 quality; transient_f1 +0.007, spec unchanged, pitch max slightly up (0.53→0.69c, harmless)
asi.next: try 48 to find the knee; watch clicks_per_m and pitch

description: XFADE_FRAMES 64→48: too short. transient_f1 0.928→0.913. 64 is the knee.

asi.hypothesis: even shorter fades = even less smear
asi.rollback_reason: quality 95.58→95.13; 48-frame fades cause spectral splatter that reads as onset timing damage
asi.next_action_hint: different lever: splice correlation window / search shape, or spec_sim at hard ratios

description: TRANSIENT_POSTPONE_RATIO 1.8→1.4: too aggressive, postponed splices get forced bigger. transient_f1 0.928→0.912.

asi.hypothesis: postpone even more splices near bursts
asi.rollback_reason: quality 95.58→95.10; over-postponement forces bigger jumps later (same failure mode as onset protection)
asi.learning: postpone ratio sweet spot is ~1.8; the postpone-vs-forced-jump tradeoff is sharp
asi.next_action_hint: try SEARCH_RANGE or CORR_WINDOW enlargement for better splice landings

description: SEARCH_RANGE 160→224: worse (spec 0.957→0.955, transient 0.928→0.919) and slower (85x→50x). Wider search parks drift further off nominal.

asi.hypothesis: wider search finds better-correlated landings
asi.rollback_reason: quality 95.58→95.27; distant candidates win ties and park drift off-nominal, and cost 40% throughput
asi.learning: SEARCH_RANGE 160 is right; splice params are all near a local optimum. Parameter tuning on SOLA is exhausted
asi.next_action_hint: structural: improve varispeed resampler quality, or attach artifact path as an additional benchmark scenario, or low-band handling at hard ratios

description: Harness sensitivity fix: transient detection hop 512→256 (measured ceiling was F1≈0.93 from quantization; now ≈0.99). New effective baseline 96.13. Real F1 headroom now visible: slow2 0.939 / fast2 0.934.

asi.hypothesis: transient_f1 was at detector-quantization ceiling
asi.finding: hop 512 self-shift F1=0.92-0.94; hop 256 = 0.98-1.0. Previous SOLA tuning partly fit quantization noise (XFADE 64 keep may need re-validation)
asi.levers: transient_f1 at hard ratios (0.934-0.939), spec_sim slow2 0.916 (low band by design)

description: Revert XFADE_FRAMES 64→96: the earlier 64-keep was fitting detector quantization noise. Under fixed metric 96 wins (96.26 vs 96.13), pitch back to 0.43/0.53c.

asi.hypothesis: XFADE 64 keep was noise-fit; re-test under hop-256 metric
asi.finding: 96-frame fades better: transient_f1 0.9463→0.9496 AND pitch 0.45/0.69→0.43/0.53. Lesson: never trust sub-ceiling metric wins
asi.learning: all SOLA params now re-anchored at original values except TRANSIENT_POSTPONE_RATIO=1.8 (kept from #3, small)

description: Re-validate TRANSIENT_POSTPONE_RATIO 3.0 vs kept 1.8: 1.8 confirmed better under fixed metric (96.26 vs 96.06, transient 0.9496 vs 0.9428). Keeping 1.8.

asi.hypothesis: check whether postpone 1.8 keep was also noise-fit
asi.rollback_reason: 3.0 is worse; 1.8 is genuinely better (+0.007 F1)
asi.learning: postpone 1.8 validated under trustworthy metric; SOLA params final: DRIFT 192/320, XFADE 96, SEARCH 160, postpone 1.8

description: Splice distance penalty 0.02→0.05: worse (F1 0.9496→0.9429). Correlation quality matters more than drift centering.

asi.hypothesis: stronger pull toward nominal reduces drift timing skew
asi.rollback_reason: 96.26→96.01; worse-correlated landings hurt more than centered drift helps
asi.next_action_hint: try CORR_WINDOW 448, then move to structural ideas

description: CORR_WINDOW 320→448: F1 up (0.9511) but spec down, pitch p95 0.43→1.46c, and seam-recovery test fails (−6.69 dB parked drift de-phasing). Worse overall anyway.

asi.hypothesis: longer corr window aligns low-mid content better at splices
asi.learning: CORR_WINDOW interacts with rest-recentering: longer window biases splice landings and parks drift that de-phases the crossover seam. 320 is load-bearing
asi.next_action_hint: SOLA micro-tuning fully exhausted; go structural (low-band at hard ratios, or varispeed resampler)

description: Quiet-gap opportunistic splicing (drift>96 + both spans <0.6x avg energy → splice early): quality 96.26→96.39, transient_f1 0.9496→0.9538, pitch unchanged.

asi.hypothesis: splice early in quiet gaps so fewer splices are forced near attacks
asi.result: +0.13 quality via F1 +0.004; first structural win. Placement > protection confirmed
asi.next: tune QUIET_SPLICE_RATIO (0.5? 0.75?) and/or lower the quiet-splice drift threshold

description: QUIET_SPLICE_RATIO 0.6→0.75: too permissive, splices in medium-energy audio. F1 0.9538→0.9397.

asi.hypothesis: more quiet-gap splices = fewer forced ones
asi.rollback_reason: 96.39→95.96; 0.75x avg is not actually quiet in dense EDM

description: QUIET_SPLICE_RATIO 0.6→0.5: also worse (F1 0.9538→0.9409). 0.6 is the sweet spot.

asi.hypothesis: stricter quiet gate
asi.rollback_reason: 96.39→96.00; non-monotone response — 0.5 misses useful gaps AND changes which splices happen (chaotic re-timing)
asi.learning: QUIET_SPLICE_RATIO=0.6 locally optimal; note metric responds chaotically to splice-timing changes (±0.01 F1), treat small deltas skeptically
asi.next_action_hint: lower OPPORTUNISTIC_DRIFT for quiet splicing (e.g. 64) so corrections are even smaller, or move on to identity/spec levers

description: Harness: add 2nd scored track (Hot Stuff, disco-house 120bpm) — overfit guard. New effective baseline 95.06; track B transient_f1 is much worse (0.82-0.91), real headroom found.

asi.hypothesis: single-track score risks overfitting to splice timing
asi.finding: Hot Stuff F1: slow 0.906 fast 0.861 slow2 0.861 fast2 0.819 — far worse than track A; speedups worst. Spec similar between tracks
asi.levers: track B transient_f1 fast2=0.819 is the biggest target now
